$comment: Compliance policies evaluated by the assessment rules (Section 6 of the specification).

nistIr8547.$comment: NIST IR 8547 (Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards): quantum-vulnerable algorithms at 112-bit classical strength are deprecated after 2030; all quantum-vulnerable algorithms are disallowed after 2035.

cnsa2.$comment: CNSA 2.0 approved algorithm set (symmetric and PQC). Hybrid combiners are compliant when every PQ constituent is on this list.

migrationPriority.$comment: Priority assigned to quantum-vulnerable assets. Confidentiality functions are exposed to harvest-now-decrypt-later and therefore rank first.
